change.title: Add exact Skill operation planning and durable control boundary
change.summary: Adds an opt-in, confirmation-gated Skill operation protocol beside the unchanged legacy bridge. The resolver remains an inspect-and-private-stage boundary; the semantic operation ledger and Gateway own the production trusted caller, coordination, capability issuance, and confirmation consumption. Exact GitHub staging binds distinct inspection and materialized-package digests, semantic installed-owned-Skill removal plans, operation-ledger projection, non-durable post-effect readback, and caller-opened private root identities are source contracts only. Reserved cleanup is strict, and every install/removal/reservation shares the four-entry lifecycle cap; removal GC receives the real operation staging root. Bundles, plugins, MCP and omitted confirmation retain their existing fail-closed or legacy boundaries.

basis: confirmation omission remains on the existing legacy installer and uninstaller paths
semantic removal plans bind the exact CSSwitch ownership marker, canonical installed content, target identity, and ordered OPERON detach then package quarantine effects
post-effect successor-persist failures return immediate trusted true/false/unknown observation plus recovery_required and are closed only by operation-id-only reconcile
after a removal rename, either held parent sync failure is mutation-visible and durability-uncertain; only reconcile readback plus both parent syncs may record Verified
continuation retains immediate INSTALL_BUSY, then locks before sealed marker/content readback
nested exact staging fsyncs retained child directories bottom-up before root sync and rename

RUST-SKILL-PACKAGE catalog discovery includes plan::tests::confirmable_skills_root_identity_is_nonzero_and_digest_sealed, which proves the bound Skills root device and inode are nonzero and sealed by the plan digest

adversarial source tests bind install skills-root identity into the plan and ledger, retain the no-follow removal leaf from WAL intent through rename, and prove mailbox forgeries cannot create authority operations

removal payload readback uses an RAII-owned DIR stream and shared directory/dirent budgets (including empty directories and marker entries); budget or drift rejection occurs before a native detach call
macOS RENAME_EXCL protects only destination no-clobber; no source-inode CAS exists. A same-UID direct writer is outside the capability boundary; observable drift fails closed without a rollback claim

mode-0700 roots enforce a shared four-entry install/removal/reservation cap; removal GC receives real operation staging, while Reserved cleanup deletes only a deterministic no-follow 0700/0600 bounded archive/receipt whitelist
no artifact, installed runtime, live provider, signing, or release claim is made
